title: Fake Bank Fraud-Department Call
caller: claims to be from the bank's fraud department

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Hello, this is the fraud department at your bank. We've detected suspicious activity on your account.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Oh no, what kind of activity?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Someone is trying to withdraw $2,300 right now. To stop it, we need to verify your identity immediately.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: I'm going to send a code to your phone. Read it back to me so I can confirm it's really you.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Shouldn't I call the number on my card?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: There's no time for that, the transfer will go through. Don't hang up. For your safety we need to move your money to a secure account I'll set up for you now.
